VoIP & SIP Troubleshooting: Investigate common voice issues such as call failures, audio quality, dropped calls, registration faults and signalling issues using SIP traces, packet captures and monitoring data. Major Incident Response: Follow defined processes for P1/P2 incidents, including incident bridges, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and accurate incident documentation. Runbook Execution: Follow established runbooks and operational procedures for known failure scenarios, including first-level remediation, route failover and traffic rerouting where applicable. Voice Quality & Capacity Monitoring: Track voice and network performance indicators such as jitter, latency and packet loss, identifying degradation or capacity constraints requiring action. Interconnect Support: Monitor interconnect performance, raise and manage fault tickets, and support routing, SIP trunking, number provisioning and interconnect activities where required. CCaaS Platform Operations: Monitor contact centre services including voice, queueing, routing, agent registration, call recording and integrations, resolving or escalating operational issues as appropriate. Documentation & Handover: Maintain clear incident records, ticket updates, runbooks and shift handovers, ensuring information is accurate and useful to colleagues, customers and other technical teams.
